evals.prompt: Show a safe Node integration for a one-off Dropbox Sign NDA in development, but do not send anything.
evals.expected_output: Uses live search/show/sdk, a non-embedded test-mode flow, controlled data, local dry-run, credential safety, callbacks, and explicit production approval.

evals.prompt: Design a weekly template-based onboarding agreement and explain when the signed PDF is ready.
evals.expected_output: Validates roles and merge fields, handles template readiness, previews in test mode, verifies callbacks, and waits for the downloadable event.

evals.prompt: Review a webhook that parses JSON, trusts event_type, downloads on all-signed, and returns {ok:true}.
evals.expected_output: Requires HTTPS multipart parsing, HMAC-before-trust, idempotent duplicate/order handling, the exact acknowledgement, and delayed download.
